Display the path of the configuration file.

Prints the file that slipway reads: --config, then SLIPWAY_CONFIG, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/slipway/config.yaml. When the default file does not exist, its path is still printed and a note on stderr says so; a file named by --config or SLIPWAY_CONFIG must exist.

Examples:
  # Print the path of the configuration file
  slipway config path

Usage:
  slipway config path [flags]

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
